look_here_first: Inspect opposite toothed leaves, square stems and small unequally lobed mint-family flowers; look closely at calyx teeth and the lower corolla lobe to separate other Teucrium.
photo_note: One credited provisional species-recognition image. True diagnostic structures, taxonomy and regional BONAP nativity remain subject to review.
identification_caution: Uruguay subsp. cubense source; no basis for claiming same subspecies or county provenance in Central Texas.
